coverage.detail: INCOMPLETE: the primary receipt's own verdict is INCOMPLETE, or a required related record is absent, or the supplied finalization-index window is inconclusive. Supply the missing evidence and re-run before treating the loop as closed. This is a coverage gap, not a block.

reasons.detail: The primary receipt's OWN verdict is `incomplete` — a required acknowledgement was absent for its plan class. The action-plan follow-up was not fully exercised, so the loop is not closed out. Supply the missing acknowledgement, re-run the receipt, and re-run this closeout.

nextActions.detail: Complete the incomplete receipt / inconclusive source chain (supply the missing acknowledgement / finalization evidence upstream) and re-run.
Archive this content-free closeout (and the underlying receipt + plan + trend + finalization-index records) as CI artifacts; it is a summary, not a substitute for the records it composes.

Record the legal audit trail, obtain the external approval / signature, prove reviewer identity, file any incident record, and promote a deployment in their OWN systems — this offline closeout performs none of them.

caveats: This is a RELEASE DECISION CLOSEOUT BUNDLE: it INGESTS ONE content-free `pdfxyz.release-decision-closeout-governance-finalize-index-trend-finalize-index-trend-closeout-index-trend-action-receipt/1` document a release pipeline produced (REQUIRED), plus OPTIONAL previously produced related records (the `…-action-plan/1` plan, the `…-finalize-index-trend/1` trend, and the `…-finalize-index/1` finalization-index window), RE-VALIDATES the primary receipt against ITSELF, CROSS-CHECKS the supplied related records against what the receipt recorded, and records whether the follow-up loop reads as closed out. It is a content-free operational closeout SUMMARY ONLY — NOT a legal / compliance sign-off, an external approval / signature, an identity proof, a deployment authorization, a promotion ledger, an incident record, or an audit log.

It is offline and READ-ONLY: it makes NO network call, reads NO secret, bucket, or object, RUNS no gate / index / decision / trend / plan / receipt / governance / finalize / closeout itself, and NEVER signs, approves, publishes, promotes, deploys, notifies, archives, deletes, prunes, uploads, or mutates any receipt, plan, trend, record, index, artifact, object, or deployment. A `closed` closeout authorizes nothing; it only records that the content-free records supplied on THIS host read as a closed-out follow-up loop.

A `closed` closeout REQUIRES a usable primary receipt whose OWN verdict is `completed` AND every supplied related record coherent. It FAILS CLOSED: a missing / unreadable / tampered / wrong-schema receipt (or a receipt whose own verdict is `invalid`) is `invalid`; a receipt whose own verdict is `blocked`, a supplied cross-check record that contradicts the receipt, a tampered / unreadable related record, or a blocked source-chain window is `blocked`; a receipt whose own verdict is `incomplete`, a missing required related record, or an inconclusive source-chain window is `incomplete`; a receipt whose own verdict is `followup-open` or an advisory source-chain window is `open`; and `--strict-open` escalates an open closeout to `blocked`. It never fabricates a `closed` closeout from an untrusted receipt or an inconsistent chain.

It re-validates the primary receipt by RECONSTRUCTING its bounded Phase 83 decision from the source facets the receipt recorded (reusing the Phase 83 `computeReceipt` reducer) and requiring the recorded receipt verdict / exit code / acknowledgement coverage to re-derive, treating any disagreement as a TAMPER (`invalid`); it re-validates each supplied related record against ITSELF the same way (reusing that phase's ingest boundary). This re-derivation is TAMPER-EVIDENCE over content-free data, NOT a cryptographic signature — there is no signing key and no attested identity, so the closeout proves neither authorship nor approval, and a set of fully self-consistent fabricated records is out of its scope.

It records only bounded enums, small counts, booleans, an ISO stamp, and app-authored prose — so it carries no reviewer name or email, no filename, path, object key, bucket, URL, endpoint, region, job / user id, IP, token, raw ref, raw label, raw note, commit URL, size, byte, or digest, even from a hostile input; it never echoes any ingested record's own stamp, and it never echoes an input file path, even on an error. It accepts NO free-form note or actor name.
It is not malware scanning, sanitization, authorization, cloud validation, or deletion proof of any request or object, and it archives, deletes, uploads, promotes, approves, or mutates nothing.

receipt.disclosure: This is a content-free operational closeout SUMMARY ONLY — NOT a legal / compliance sign-off, an external approval / signature, an identity proof, a deployment authorization, a promotion ledger, an incident record, or an audit log. It ingests one previously produced action-plan execution receipt plus optional previously produced related records and records whether the finalization-index-trend follow-up loop reads as closed out; it authorizes and proves nothing, and it attests no person's identity.
